summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a routine London Stock Exchange/FCA notification) disclosing total voting rights and capital as of 31 October 2026. The company reports 8,808,341,409 ordinary shares of £0.01 issued, of which 16,238,543 are held in treasury, leaving 8,792,102,866 shares carrying voting rights. This figure is provided as the denominator for shareholders' Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules notification obligations; no transaction, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is involved. Not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
